modelEvidence.eligibility: Invalid charge-end/drive-start timestamps are excluded (105-116,147,159). Charges without valid ended_at do not enter ended counts.
modelEvidence.pairing: firstDriveAfter:129 excludes equal timestamps; candidate gap at 164 is <=24h by default; later ended session wins at 166, so one departure receives at most one charge. Other ended charges count unpaired; paired and unpaired sum to valid ended charges.
modelEvidence.dwell: 183 derives nonnegative elapsed seconds from charge end to drive start; returned value rounded at 227. Not a continuous parked measurement.
modelEvidence.readiness: 196 directly uses recorded drive-end SoC; aggregate at 255-256 averages known margins only and returns null if none known.
modelEvidence.sign: 189-195 uses drive-start minus drive-end for consumption and drive-start minus charge-end for drift. Negative drift is retained as expected parked drain, not a mismatch. Consumption may be signed; no display-side absolute value/coercion is introduced.

flags.excess_buffer: charge SoC gain minus drive SoC used >=40 percentage points; this is a SoC comparison, not measured Wh or a proof of wasted charging

flags.long_dwell: dwell >=4h only when early_full_dwell not already selected
flags.soc_mismatch: positive drive-start minus charge-end drift >=3 percentage points
